clean.tx: Ko John na fehili mai pe na tunu e ai te ika.
clean.tl: John asked who cooked the fish.

clean.tx: Ko John na lea mai pe ko te ika na tunu e Rangi.
clean.tl: John said if Rangi had cooked the fish.

clean.tx: … fehili mai ki a te au pe ko au na hau i fea.
clean.tl: … he asked me where I had come from.

clean.tx: Kae kāfai foki e hē lava tau meakai. ka lahi lele nā mea ka tutupu mai kia te koe.
clean.tl: But if your food is insufficient, there will be many things that will happen to you.

clean.tx: Na tuki e John ia Rangi
Na tuki ia Rangi e John
Ko John nae fofou ke tuki e Jess ia Rangi tāeao.
clean.tl: John wanted Jess to hit Rangi tomorrow.

clean.tx: Na taumafai ia John ke hao te vaka mai te afā.
clean.tl: John tried to escape the ship from the hurricane.

clean.tx: E mahani oi velo e John ni ika.
Na kamata oi fau e John te vaka.
clean.tl: John began to build a boat.

clean.tx: Na taumafai ia John ko te vaka ke hao mai te afā.
clean.tl: John tried to escape the ship from the hurricane.10

clean.tx: Ko John nae fofou ko Jess ke ia tukia ia Rangi.
clean.tl: John wants Jess to hit Rangi.

clean.tx: ¿Hē te haraoa o te poki era?
clean.tl: Where is the bread of that child ?

clean.tx: Ka noho, ki mau mai tuu māmātia era i te kai māau.
clean.tl: Sit down, so your aunt can bring you food.

clean.tx: E haka pihaa i te vai. Ki oti he too mai he huri he haka tano te matua puaa ki roto o te vai pihaa.
E noho nō mai ā tū taŋata era, ī ka hakaroŋo atu ena....
clean.tl: When that man was just staying , suddenly he heard …

clean.tx: Te vārua mo noho atu ōou mo ui a ruŋa i a rāua... he ui kē.
clean.tl: The spirits, when you sit down and look at them, will look away.

clean.tx: Ka ea koe ka haka rivariva i te poki, ka oho atu kōrua ki Haŋa Piko.
clean.tl: Go outside and prepare the child, and go to Hanga Piko.

flagged.tx: Kāfai ko nā atu mua e fai tamate pe fai tiaki, kua fakahētonuga loa te taumanu i te taimi tēnā.
flagged.tl: If the first skipjacks are handled so that they fall back in sea, or get foul-hooked, … the feeding-school is heedlessly ruined at once at that time.
